###Extra Chapter Theodore'S Story
Extra Chapter Theodore's Story 
Three years had passed in the blink of an eye. Theodore was released from prison. Time seemed 
neither long nor short. On the day before his release, he had specifically instructed the guards not to let 
anyone come to pick him up. He was too proud to let anyone see him in such a sorry state. 
He got into a taxi and headed home. 
The city had changed a lot over the past three years. Oscar never failed to impress him, and Northfield 
thrived under his leadership. As he drove through familiar streets, Theodore caught sight of Little 
Bunny's advertisement on a massive electronic screen. He smiled slightly at the thought of how well 
she must be doing these days before turning away and letting go of any further thoughts about her. 
The taxi soon arrived at its destination, and Theodore walked into his villa. 
As soon as he opened the door, to his surprise, he found everything was clean inside as if someone 
else had lived there recently. That was thanks to high-end housekeeping services available in this 
upscale neighbourhood, he thought. He didn't want any dust or dirt after just being released from 
prison; it would have been too much for him emotionally speaking. 
He went straight into the bedroom and turned on the shower faucet without hesitation. Finally, he was 
able to take an unrestricted shower after so long behind bars. Theodore took quite some time washing 
thoroughly until he felt completely clean again. Then he looked at himself in front of a mirror. In his 
eyes, he was ugly with a buzz-cut hairdo with a dark skin tone plus some stubble here and there. He 
grabbed his razor blade, which seemed brand new as if no one ever used it before. After shaving off all 
facial hair cleanly, he also dried his hair and changed into a clean robe. Everything in his room looked 
new, for which Theodore even wanted to praise the housekeeping service staff members in person.
After finishing up his hygiene routines, Theodore went straight towards the kitchen area, where there 
were fresh juices stored inside the refrigerator compartment labelled with today's date indicating when 
they were freshly squeezed. 
This small detail warmed up Theodore's heart. He then poured himself a cup of juice and came back to 
the sofa to watch TV. He didn't have much time to watch TV when he was in jail, only when it was lunch 
or dinner time. That was the first time he had felt contented already due partly because of having 
access once more to watching TV freely without restrictions. 
Theodore switched channels randomly until finding something interesting enough worth watching then 
fell asleep shortly thereafter. 
When he got up from the couch, it was dark outside. And he saw someone busy in his kitchen and 
smelled the aroma of food, which he was familiar with. He followed the full food flavour to the kitchen. 
The cook seemed to greet him respectfully, "Mr Wold, did I wake you up?" 
"I woke up hungry," Theodore said, "Are you the housekeeper?" 
"Yes, sir, dinner will be ready soon." 
Theodore nodded. Then he sat at the dining table and waited. He was so hungry that he salivated at 
the smell of food wafting through his nose. 
Fortunately, it didn't take long before dish after dish of delicious cuisine was placed in front of him. 
Theodore took a bite and tears almost fell from his eyes. Suddenly he felt that life was worth living 
again. He ate quite a lot and even drank some beer. 
When Theodore was full and satisfied, he asked, "How do I let your boss know that I'm very satisfied 
with your service?"
"It's my honour to satisfy you, sir." Said the housekeeper humbly. 
"In future, I'll request you to provide me with housekeeping services." 
"Thank you, Mr Wold, I will try my best to do better." 
Theodore nodded then left the dining table to sit on the couch again while holding onto the remote

attention on screen-Little Bunny was receiving an award at an awards ceremony for Best Actress 
presented by Addison Chasey. They looked like a perfect couple on the screen. Theodore's heart still 
hurt when seeing them together but couldn't help but continue watching. 
Addison transitioned into directing films. And as a new director, he presented the trophy to Little Bunny. 
When they were standing together on the stage, the audience made some noise while the host joked 
with them. 
Theodore wondered if they had taken their relationship out in the open. But then he persuaded himself 
into their relationship with a reason that being in an open relationship would harm their popularity.

became shallow and rapid as he struggled to keep calm and not lose control of himself or embrace 
Little Bunny tightly.
"What are you doing here?" 
"Waiting for you." Little Bunny laughed and added, "I've been waiting for you." 
"I don't need your gratitude for everything I've done..." 
Before he could finish speaking, Little Bunny kissed him deeply on the lips. Theodore froze completely 
still like a statue. Then she said softly, "Theodore, I love you." 
His heart trembled within his chest as she spoke each word slowly with a deep emotion behind them, 
"I'm waiting for you because I love you. I love you so much." 
Tears flowed down her cheeks as she gazed lovingly into Theodore. 
"I saw you on the screen today." He said with suppressed emotions. "You and Addison are a good 
match." 
"Did you see the end?" asked she. 
Theodore appeared somewhat puzzled. 
"Dummy," Little Bunny couldn't help but blurt out. She knew Theodore was released from prison today. 
But she couldn't wait for him at home because of the award ceremony. So she prepared all the things 
he needed for his release from prison, asked the housekeeping to cook his favourite dishes for him, 
and then confessed to him at the award ceremony in front of the people of the whole country. No matter 
whether Theodore would see it or not, she just wanted him to know that she loved him. He was the only 
one she loved. 
"At last, there is someone, in particular, I want to thank, someone the most important in my life, 
someone I miss so much. Today is his day to go home, and I regret not being able to wait for him at 
home, give him a warm hug in the first place, and tell him that I've been waiting for him all along. I don't
know if he has seen me in front of the TV at the moment, but I want to tell you in this way, that I love 
you, very very much." She repeated the last sentence that Theodore had not heard. 
Tears welled up in Theodore's eyes. He hugged Little Bunny tight. 
"Little Bunny, even if..." 
Even if you're lying to me, even if you're just pitying me. 
"I won't let go anymore." With that said, he squeezed Little Bunny in his arms as if the two of them 
would become one flesh. 
Little Bunny also wrapped her arms around him. It was a long-awaited embrace, a sense of security 
she had never felt before. Fortunately, neither of them gave up in the end. 
"I love you, Little Bunny." 
"I love you too, Theodore."
